summary: Workstream 3 Phase B storefront i18n testing on customer web. Verified 8 of 10 acceptance criteria. WORKING: (1) Cart deep-link ?lang=fr/en flips copy live ('Votre panier est vide/Découvrir les produits' ↔ 'Your cart is empty/Browse products'). (2b) MobileCheckout FR/EN — title (Finaliser ma commande / Checkout), 'Adresse de livraison'/'Delivery address', 'Mode de paiement'/'Payment method', 'Confirmer la commande'/'Place order' all translate. (3) MobileProductDetail on /products/prd_6f0ccf125a894bfd (Banane Cavendish) — 'Ajouter au panier'+'Description' render in FR, 'Add to cart'+'Description' in EN. (5) MobileProfile guest FR shows 'Connectez-vous pour accéder à votre profil'+'Se connecter'; EN shows 'Sign in to access your profile'+'Sign in'. (8) Desktop ProductDetailPage — 'Ajouter au panier'+'Vous aimerez peut-être' in FR; 'Add to cart'+'You may also like' in EN. (10) Regression /shop hero + /send redirect both fine. FAIL / MISSING: (1) FR-first default REGRESSION — every fresh visit test (context.clear_cookies + localStorage.clear via init-script and page.evaluate) landed on English copy on /cart with baked_language=en persisted; only ?lang=fr query forces FR. (6) Mobile Home / — 'Voir tout'/'View all' NOT visible anywhere on the mobile / route because path '/' is routed to <ConfigHomepage/>, NOT <MobileHome/>. All SectionHeader linkLabels in the config are overridden to custom FR labels (Voir les catégories, Voir les offres, Découvrez plus) — but ConfigHomepage.jsx still contains 2 hardcoded English literals ('View all' at L279 CategoryGrid.linkLabel and L514 carousel Link) that DON'T translate on toggle. (4) MobileWallet — guest hits an auth-gate wrapper that renders untranslated English 'Sign in to view your wallet / Track your BAKĒD balance and transactions across every service. / Continue to sign in' regardless of ?lang=fr; MobileWallet body itself is not reachable without auth so 'Portefeuille'/'Aucune transaction' could not be verified. (7) MobileOrderConfirmation — /orders/fake_id/confirmation renders 'Loading…' shell forever (waiting on order fetch that 404s); page shell never falls back to a translated static state so neither 'Commande confirmée' nor 'Order confirmed' visible. Can't be tested without a real order. (9) Language switcher round-trip PARTIALLY BROKEN — desktop popover [data-testid=top-nav-language-switcher] → [top-nav-language-en] flips to EN and persists localStorage.baked_language='en' + i18next.language='en'. However on the SECOND popover open (to go back to FR) [data-testid=top-nav-language-fr] never becomes visible before 30s timeout, so FR round-trip via switcher UI fails. The Popover state appears not to reopen cleanly after selection. Deep-link/URL flip still works.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded English `linkLabel="View all"` — overrides t('home.shop_all') fallback, so the shop-by-category section on customer mobile `/` ALWAYS shows 'View all' and never toggles to 'Voir tout' in FR. Task spec says 'ConfigHomepage (SectionHeader View all → shop_all)' — not applied.
Hardcoded English literal `View all` in the desktop carousel viewall Link (`hp-carousel-viewall-*`). Same issue — never translates.

FR-first default regression: after context.clear_cookies() + localStorage.clear() + reload, /cart renders in English and localStorage.baked_language=='en'. Expected: FR (task requirement #1 and Phase A behaviour). Likely cause — a persisted cookie 'baked_language' from earlier iteration survives clear_cookies() (i18n detector caches to both localStorage + cookie; cookie may be scoped in a way that clear_cookies doesn't purge), or detector picks up an htmlTag 'en' before detectInitialLanguage() writes. Deep-link ?lang=fr still overrides. Recommend: (a) drop 'cookie' from detection.order/caches so localStorage is the only persistence surface, or (b) explicitly force i18n.changeLanguage(detectInitialLanguage()) on AppProvider mount to override any stale cookie.

Guest visitors on /wallet see an English-only auth prompt: 'Sign in to view your wallet / Track your BAKĒD balance and transactions across every service. / Continue to sign in'. These strings are not wired through t()/customer.wallet.* keys; no FR fallback. Wraps <MobileWallet/> before it renders, so the migrated i18n strings inside MobileWallet.jsx are unreachable for unauth users.

Partial i18n migration: while `t('product.add_to_cart')` and `t('product.description')` translate correctly, adjacent labels on the same page remain hardcoded English regardless of ?lang=fr — visible strings: 'Product Details', 'View more details', 'Select quantity', 'You may also like', 'View all', 'ADD'. Consider extending Phase B keys or filing follow-up.

After selecting EN in the Popover, reopening [data-testid=top-nav-language-switcher] does NOT re-render [data-testid=top-nav-language-fr] within 30s (Playwright timeout). The Popover appears to remain in some intermediate state after first close; second open never mounts children. As a result the switcher cannot round-trip EN→FR via UI on desktop. localStorage / URL flip still works.

Route /orders/:id/confirmation on a non-existent id renders only 'Loading…' indefinitely — no translated static shell (title/CTA) surfaces. Can't validate 'Commande confirmée'/'Continuer mes achats' vs 'Order confirmed'/'Continue shopping'. Consider a translated fallback for load-error / 404 orders.

integration_issues.issue: Popover reopen after first selection fails to mount language options. Blocks the switcher round-trip requirement.

action_items: Replace ConfigHomepage.jsx L279 `linkLabel="View all"` with `linkLabel={t('home.shop_all')}` (or drop the prop so SectionHeader uses its default t('home.shop_all')).
Replace ConfigHomepage.jsx L514 hardcoded 'View all <ArrowRight />' with `{t('home.shop_all')} <ArrowRight />` (import useTranslation('customer') at the top of the carousel component).

Fix FR-first regression: force `i18n.changeLanguage(language)` unconditionally on AppProvider first mount, OR drop 'cookie' from detection.order and detection.caches in /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.js so a stale baked_language cookie can't override the FR fallback.

Translate the /wallet guest sign-in gate — either wrap it in the same i18n namespace or route the guest gate through customer.wallet.* keys (e.g. wallet.guest_prompt, wallet.guest_body, wallet.guest_cta).

Fix TopNav language Popover reopen — the second open never mounts children. Suspect PopoverContent unmount/remount race after setLanguage → i18n.changeLanguage → parent re-render. Verify with a dedicated key on PopoverContent or force close-before-open.
Consider extending MobileProductDetail migration to cover the remaining hardcoded literals: 'Product Details', 'View more details', 'Select quantity', 'You may also like', 'View all', 'ADD'.
Provide a translated fallback state for MobileOrderConfirmation when the order fetch fails / 404s (currently stuck on 'Loading…').
critical_code_review_comments: ConfigHomepage.jsx contains 2 hardcoded English literals ('View all' L279 + L514) after Phase B claims to have migrated its SectionHeader — this is the direct cause of the failing acceptance criterion #6.

Mobile / route serves ConfigHomepage (App L154), not MobileHome — the task brief mentions MobileHome as the migrated file but the actually rendered page for guests on `/` is ConfigHomepage. If MobileHome is dead code on mobile /, either wire it in or delete it to reduce confusion.

i18n detection order caches to both localStorage AND cookie. If a stale cookie sneaks in (as happens after context.clear_cookies() in some Playwright / preview-URL setups), the cookie will pin the language to 'en' and defeat the French-first default forever. Recommend dropping 'cookie' from detection.caches (localStorage alone is enough for our SPA).

MobileWallet is technically migrated but users never see it as guests — the outer auth-gate string set is untranslated and blocks Phase B's spirit. The gate is defined outside the migrated file — flag for full migration.
TopNav Popover language switcher regression on second-open blocks the switcher round-trip acceptance criterion. Priority fix.
test_credentials: Not exercised — Phase B focused on guest storefront strings; wallet and order-confirmation require auth so their FR/EN interior could not be validated without login.
